  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      MANAGER_SOURCE:
        type: choice
        description: "KernelSU 分支(SPOOF=伪装版管理器)"
        required: true
        default: RESUKISU
        options:
          - RESUKISU
          - RESUKISU_SPOOF
          - SUKISU
          - SUKISU_SPOOF
      KPM:
        type: choice
        description: "内核模块实现方式(仅SukiSU-Ultra支持)"
        required: true
        default: N/A
        options:
          - KPM
          - KPN
          - N/A
      SUSFS_META:
        type: string
        description: "回退SUSFS(输入哈希或次数或-1关闭，SukiSU-Ultra不能关闭)"
        required: false
        default: ""
      BUILD_TIME:
        type: string
        description: "自定义构建时间(默认与原厂内核一致；输入F使用当前UTC时间)"
        required: false
        default: "Mon Oct 24 22:45:30 UTC 2022"
      KSU_META:
        type: string
        description: "分支名(留空用默认)/自定义版本标识(留空不修改)/回退提交哈希(留空不修改)"
        required: false
        default: "//"
      SUFFIX:
        type: string
        description: "自定义内核后缀(默认与原厂内核一致；清空则使用随机字符串)"
        required: false
        default: "9-00011-g8efa13274425-ab9212784"
      SUBLEVEL:
        description: "自定义内核等级欺骗(SUBLEVEL)"
        required: false
        default: ""
      LSM_BBG:
        type: boolean
        description: "是否启用关键分区写入保护模块(BBG)？"
        required: true
        default: true
      CCM:
        type: boolean
        description: "是否编入 BBR / BBRv3 拥塞控制算法？（不改默认算法）"
        required: true
        default: true
      UNICODE_BYPASS:
        type: boolean
        description: "是否添加Unicode不可见字码点绕过读取漏洞修复？"
        required: true
        default: true
      DROID_SPACES:
        type: boolean
        description: "是否添加轻量级Linux容器支持(DroidSpaces)？"
        required: true
        default: false
      RE_KERNEL:
        type: boolean
        description: "是否添加Re-Kernel？"
        required: true
        default: false
      SUSFS_DEV:
        type: boolean
        description: "是否拉取SUSFS-DEV分支？"
        required: true
        default: false
      SPACE_NOCLEAN:
        type: boolean
        description: "是否停用空间清扫？"
        required: true
        default: false
      RELEASE:
        type: boolean
        description: "是否发布到 Release？(默认不发布，需要时手动勾选)"
        required: true
        default: false
      BUILD_NOCCACHE:
        type: boolean
        description: "是否停用此次Ccache？"
        required: true
        default: false
